name: Rhazmora, RBF of the Schism
summary: The beast of the Schism: every assigned Object digs through the deck, and the Nexus rearms the Front from the Retire Zone.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: You control at least 3 Entities with an Object assigned. Put an Auros Entity from your Retire Zone into the Abyss, then flip.

faceA.name: Rhazmora, RBF of the Schism

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: The first time each of your turns you assign an Object to an Entity, look at the top and bottom card of your deck: you may swap them. Then draw a card and discard a card.

swiftForge.name: Swift Forge
swiftForge.text: the next Object card you play this turn costs 1 less Flux.

calibratedStrike.name: Calibrated Strike
calibratedStrike.text: an Entity with an Object assigned you control gets +2 Power until end of turn.

faceA.flavor: Where Rhazmora passed, the world was left in two.

faceB.name: Heart of the Schism

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 12 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: The first time each of your turns you assign an Object to an Entity, look at the top and bottom card of your deck: add one of them to your hand and put the other into your Retire Zone.

deepForge.name: Deep Forge
deepForge.text: the next Object card you play this turn costs 2 less Flux.

bladeChorus.name: Chorus of Blades
bladeChorus.text: Entities with an Object assigned you control get +1 Power until end of turn.

greatRearm.name: Great Rearmament
greatRearm.text: assign any number of Objects from your Retire Zone to as many Entities without an Object on your Front, without paying their Flux cost.

faceB.flavor: The Schism is not a wound. It is a door.
